name: jog
description: Syntax highlighting and diagnostics for Jog

jog.serverPath.description: Path to the Jog language server executable. Empty uses the bundled bin/server (or server.exe), then server/out/server in the JogLSP checkout.

jog.compilerPath.description: Path to JogCompiler v2 jog (or jog-v2). User/workspace settings win, then JOG, then ~/.local/bin/jog-v2, then the JogCompiler-v2 zig-out binary. The v2 language server runs jog check --diag=json.

jog.root.description: Optional JOG_ROOT. v2 diagnostics do not require std/ next to the binary yet; kept for forward compatibility.
